taskRules.Why: Free-form chat tolerates rounding: small wording changes rarely matter. Q4_K_M loses ~1–3% on benchmarks. Models under 4B lose more, so keep them at Q6+.
taskRules.Recommended model families: Qwen3, Llama 3.x, Gemma 3, Mistral Small, gpt-oss

taskRules.Why: Must reproduce facts from long context faithfully; very low bits raise hallucination and weaken long-context recall. Prefer 8-bit KV over lowering weight bits.
taskRules.Affinity keywords: Command R; Command A; Qwen3; Llama 3.3; Granite; Gemma 3
taskRules.Recommended model families: Qwen3, Llama 3.3, Command R/A, Gemma 3, Granite

taskRules.Why: Code needs exact tokens: one wrong bracket, name or indent breaks the program, and errors compound over long outputs. Below Q5, models under 30B make noticeably more syntax/API mistakes; ≥30B models stay robust at Q4_K_M; <4B coders need Q8.
taskRules.Affinity keywords: Coder; Codestral; Devstral; CodeGemma; gpt-oss; Laguna
taskRules.Recommended model families: Qwen2.5-Coder, Qwen3-Coder, Devstral, Codestral, gpt-oss, Laguna

taskRules.Why: Long step-by-step reasoning amplifies small numeric errors; thinking models emit thousands of tokens so drift accumulates. Arithmetic accuracy drops first at Q4 and below on models <30B.
taskRules.Affinity keywords: R1; QwQ; reasoning; Magistral; gpt-oss; Qwen3
taskRules.Recommended model families: DeepSeek-R1 distills, QwQ, Qwen3, Phi-4-reasoning, gpt-oss, Magistral

taskRules.Why: Tool calls must emit exact JSON, function names and arguments; low bits increase malformed calls, and agent loops repeat the error. Keep ≥Q5 below 30B.
taskRules.Affinity keywords: gpt-oss; Qwen3; Devstral; Mistral Small; Llama 3.3; Nemotron; GLM; Kimi; MiniMax
taskRules.Recommended model families: gpt-oss, Qwen3, Devstral, Mistral Small, GLM, Kimi

taskRules.Why: Model must be a VLM. Keep the vision encoder (mmproj) at FP16/Q8; the language part follows chat rules (≥Q4_K_M).
taskRules.Recommended model families: Qwen2.5-VL, Gemma 3, Pixtral, Llama 3.2 Vision, Qwen3.8 27B

taskRules.Why: Short, constrained outputs (labels, fields, entities) tolerate quantization well; small models at Q4_K_M are usually enough. Validate on a labelled sample.
Low-resource languages degrade first under quantization (rare tokens lose precision). Keep ≥Q5 below 30B for non-English quality.
taskRules.Recommended model families: Aya Expanse, Qwen3, Gemma 3, Command A
